text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival! 
The Umamusume take on various games to 
entertain the fans who always support 
them.
As for North Flight—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer... I'm counting on your 
support.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“On everything I've lived through so 
far... and on my pride—I'm going to win!”

—She was burning with unusual passion. 
Yes, the event she was taking on today 
was...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the Tracen Academy 
Cup Fuchu Costume Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, this event is a costume race! 
You draw a slip of paper with a prompt, 
and use the goods provided to make a 
costume to match it.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
There are three prompts in total! Seeing 
the creative ways rivals set themselves 
apart on the same prompt is part of the 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Points awarded for your finishing order 
plus points for how well your costume fits 
the theme— the winner will be decided by 
the total of the two!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This immensely popular annual race! And 
now, let us move on to introducing this 
year's contenders.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"First up, Curren Chan enters Gate 1, 
Bracket 1! She's radiating cuteness in all 
directions once again today!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Let me show you cute Curren's 
outfit♪"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bracket 6, Number 8, Fine Motion! Stepping 
gracefully and lightly, she looks in great 
condition!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to this♪ I 
wonder if they have ramen hats and stuff?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bracket 4, Gate 4, Rhein Kraft enters the 
gate! It seems she also helped make the 
costume items!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Since I'm here... I hope I win my 
'Sunshine Set.'"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And here she comes! The race favorite, 
North Flight, in Gate 12, Bracket 8— 
W-What... What incredible presence!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Costumes are, in essence, disguises... 
which means they fall right into my 
domain.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —I cannot lose, not ever...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—The "Tracsen Academy Cup Fuchu Costume 
Stakes" has begun! It's a clean, even 
break for everyone!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And the Umamusume charge all at once 
toward the prompt boxes! Leading the pack 
first is Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, "The Cheerful Dancer"! That sounds 
fun♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Like the image of a masquerade ball? If 
so... yeah, that sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's search for the evening dress, the 
mask... and the diamond necklace.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...I see. My topic isâ"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"A Celebrity's Holiday"... In other words, 
a blend of celebrity elegance and 
relaxation.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As for the image... a resort? A beach, or 
maybe a summer retreat...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A dress seems likely, but... maybe not 
with a relaxed silhouette. I want 
something made of sheer fabric—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, let's rethink our direction. If we 
start from the items...

...Flight was lost in thought. Meanwhile, 
the other Umamusume finished their 
costumes one after another and headed for 
the goal.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay♪ Curren's in 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Curren-san's theme is... "Celebrity's Day 
Off." ...Yep, it's perfect! Full marks!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Does that mean... Curren wins?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ Thanks to whoever gave me the 
frappe~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ! Oh, you're right.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As a general image, sunglasses give off an 
aura of celebrity.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And flexibly borrowing items from the 
audience to create a relaxed vibe, too...! 
Truly marvelous...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're overthinking it! There's that bad 
habit of yours coming out again, Flight!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! So frustrating!

I got too caught up in the details, and in 
the end I couldn't finish my costume or 
reach the goal...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
W-What an abstract prompt. This is... 
quite troubling.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"A cool knight"... Hmm, that might be the 
exact opposite of the sun!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um, let's see! A cool knight... A cool—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If I brought Cesario along— No, I 
guess that wouldn't work.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...! Right. Maybe that's fine!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Craft-chan! I'll gladly take 
that idea!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, North Flight darts forward! What 
item will she choose—... Wait!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
North Flight blows right past the items! 
Is she heading straight for the goal...?!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
North Flight takes 1st! Points are added! 
However... she is not in costume!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: No, look closely. At my prompt.

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
—"High Fashion Runway"... I see. This 
theme assumes a runway collection vibe, 
but...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is why... I came to challenge 
you just as I am.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I've always loved fashion, and I live 
holding my head high no matter when or 
where, as if I'm walking down a runway.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I myself... am fashion, and the runway!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Please act as our judge!

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Is this... a runway!?

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
"...That dignified demeanor, and that 
refined sense of style that shines through 
even in standard gym clothes..."

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
—Points added for North Flight-san! Full 
marks! Therefore, the winner is... you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! However... I still 
have some regrets.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the fans were really looking 
forward to seeing all kinds of costumes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I was being a bit pushy. I hope I 
didn't disappoint you...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san! Congrats~! I could see all 
kinds of stylish outfits on you in my mind 
too!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Flawless speed too! Congratulations~! You 
are the winner!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right! ...Yay♪

Having embodied the prompt perfectly, 
North Flight crossed the finish line at 
top speed to thunderous applause from the 
entire venue!
